performance-loop-protocol.target: average full-path warm game strictly below 50 ms
performance-loop-protocol.sampling: 8 alternating one-match release runs per arm; 32 games each; normal production shuffles; every observation retained
performance-loop-protocol.stall: 10 consecutive attempts without a repeatable >=1% improvement; statistical check uses standard error of run means to avoid treating random-game variation as significant
performance-loop-protocol.scope: No full soak. No full application suite. All samples use the same worktree filesystem and power configuration; no power settings changed.
